SELECT s.id, s.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, s.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, s.course_id AS courseId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.assistant_name AS assistantName, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.room, s.topic, s.status, s.lesson_mode AS lessonMode, s.teaching_log_id AS teachingLogId, s.should_count AS shouldCount, s.actual_count AS actualCount FROM schedule s JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = s.campus_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id
ORDER BY s.lesson_date, s.start_time, s.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = '已上课'), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = '待上课'), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(s.should_count), 0) AS shouldStudents, COALESCE(SUM(s.actual_count), 0) AS actualStudents, COUNT(DISTINCT s.class_id) AS classes FROM schedule s

SELECT DISTINCT s.class_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS name FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id WHERE s.class_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name

SELECT DISTINCT s.course_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS name FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id WHERE s.course_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT DISTINCT teacher_name FROM schedule WHERE teacher_name IS NOT NULL AND teacher_name <> '' ORDER BY teacher_name
SELECT DISTINCT room FROM schedule WHERE room IS NOT NULL AND room <> '' ORDER BY room
